title: The Sprite Station (DS)
wikitext:
{{InfoNeeded}}

In ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]]'' and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]'' there are 9 "Channels" to access, with each of them serving a different purpose. In the very beginning of the game the only available channels are 1, (Weather) and 8, (Tutorials). To unlock the other channels, you have to meet certain requirements.

Each channel is run by a Sprite Operator, which are each named after a different planet. Ch.1 is run by Mercury, Ch.2 Venus, Ch.4 Earth, and so on.

==Channel 1: Weather==
[[File:Station_chan1.png|right|90px]]

You can see the next day's weather by watching this station.

*Available at the beginning of the game.

==Channel 2: TV Shopping==
[[File:Station_chan2.png|right|90px]]

You can buy items from this station. When you see an item you want to buy, use the telephone to call the operators to buy it.

*'''To Unlock''': Buy an item from Karen's Supermarket via the telephone for 10 days.

*'''Note''': Not all things shown on this channel are actually for sale, like the Helicopter, for example.

==Channel 3: Sprite Profile==
[[File:Station_chan3.png|right|90px]]

You can use this channel to find out information about the sprites, such as their favorite gifts or their birthdays. This channel also has a hint section, where it will give you clues on where to find sprites you haven't unlocked yet.

*'''To Unlock''': Find 20 sprites.

==Channel 4: Farm Information==
[[File:Station_chan4.png|right|90px]]

This channel gives you tips on how to take care of your farm. It will also turn on automatically the day a wild dog appears on your farm.

*'''To Unlock''': Ship 300 of ''one'' item that you have produced on your farm. Items made with a Maker ''do not'' count.

==Channel 5: DJ==
[[File:Station_chan5.png|right|90px]]

Use this channel to change the background music of your game.

*'''To Unlock''': Buy 5 (or more) records from Jet in the Sprite Tree.

*'''Note''': If you activate a different music while playing (like event music), the music will revert to the default background music and you would have to change it to the other music you want again.

==Channel 6: News==
[[File:Station_chan6.png|right|90px]]

This channel's operator will list all of the current season's festivals.

*'''To Unlock''': ''Participate'' in 3 Seasonal Events (not just attend).

==Channel 7: Variety==
[[File:Station_chan7.png|right|90px]]

Every week you can watch an episode of "Rookie Detective Kanako" on this channel.

*'''To Unlock''': Get at least 1 villager to 100 FP, then the channel will be unlocked the next morning.
*'''Note''': In the Japanese version of the game, there are multiple shows you can watch.

==Channel 8: Tutorials==
[[File:Station_chan8.png|right|90px]]

If you ever need help or fogot how to do something, refer to this channel.

*Available at the beginning of the game.

==Channel 9: Quiz Show==
[[File:Station_chan9.png|right|90px]]

Once unlocked, this channel will quiz you daily on your knowledge of [[Harvest Moon: A Wonderful Life|AWL]], [[Harvest Moon: Another Wonderful Life|AnWL]], [[Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town|FoMT]], and [[Harvest Moon: More Friends of Mineral Town|MFoMT]]. Every time you answer 35 questions correctly, you'll get a prize valued at 1000 G.

*'''To Unlock''': This is the hardest channel to unlock. To do so, ship 100,000 of a specific item produced on your farm. Just like Channel 4, items produced in Makers ''do not'' count.

==Trivia==
* When you finish watching a show on Sprite Station, the announcer will always say "See you next week!" meaning the other shows were planned to be translated as well. It could most likely be a mistake.
